scope: Exploratory mechanism diagnosis on already-seen tests; no new deployable agent or generalization claim.
paid_authorization: User authorized this new round without a monetary cap; no paid calls planned or necessary for offline protocol.
state_sampling: All 89 initial V3 decisions, all 141 interventions, and decision quartiles of 16 discordant + hash-selected 4 both-success + 4 both-failure families; deduplicate by family/index.
single_step_scope: Every committed V3 hard action and every logged candidate; reconstruct saved pre-action learner and selector; check original C0 scoring exactly.

search.algorithm: Deterministic bounded weighted best-first search on full official-engine transitions; priority g+2*h; admissibility/minimality NOT claimed.
search.vocabulary: Recursive goal recipe ingredients/products, relevant item/container transfers, all neighboring movement, key and torch. No reference witness or future logged actions are supplied to C0-C3 searches.
search.state_abstraction: Physical inventory/map + task/quest/combat state and clock; full paths replayed twice. Search failure, frontier pruning and node/depth limits are UNKNOWN, never proof of impossibility.
search.budget_policy: Same fixed bounds for each distinct first action; exact-state cache only, no result-driven reruns or tuning.

conditions.C0: Frozen learner, saved public state/outcome history, original Selector.score/choose; reproduce recorded action.
conditions.C1: Replace predict with true action-rule rejection (p=0/1, confidence=1) and actual violated conditions. Original public state, goal, candidate multiset, costs, score/choose unchanged. No route/next-action data.
conditions.C2: Retain learned p/confidence and extra-call/switch costs. Replace single-step task term with 1.7*Q_K, Q_K=0.9**(d-1) for a replay-verified path of length d<=K, else zero verified lower bound. Retain margin .2 and confidence>=.65; switch only to candidate with verified positive Q_K. This is a conservative diagnostic of the value term; separately report ungated candidate upper bound.
conditions.C3: Same as C2, with Oracle precondition p/confidence. Candidate list/state/goal/search outputs identical to C2.
conditions.bounds: Q_K=0 means no verified witness found, NOT true zero value. All improvements are witness-discovery/lower-bound changes; report unknown and paired identification bounds. Distances are shortest FOUND verified paths, never global shortest.
conditions.upper: Independent search from the frozen state with broader diagnostic vocabulary; its first action may be added ONLY in a separately-labelled candidate-generation upper bound. Frozen dataset witness may be replayed ONLY at initial states in this separate upper bound. Never feed it to C0-C3.

intervention_metrics.MSIB: Paired verified-path discovery difference at K for recorded intervention vs base first action, plus interval accounting for UNKNOWN on either branch; not closed-loop agent Recovery@K.
intervention_metrics.waste: Report proven physical no-op/cycles separately; no condition progress and no found path is only unverified progress, not definitive waste. Strict zero-task-progress only when a branch immediately ends without goal; all censored cases remain unknown.

statistics: One family is a cluster. Family-mean paired differences, fixed 10000 bootstrap seed 20261012; source/mechanism sensitivity; descriptive exploratory comparisons without multiplicity claims.
